purpose: Claims for the pilot user study (12 claims, two sets of 6 counterbalanced across assisted/unassisted conditions).
how_chosen: scripts/select_study_claims.py candidates (seed 718; 3 eligible claims per gold-label x model-output cell), then curated by hand toward 6 claims the baseline classified correctly and 6 it classified wrongly, which roughly matches its 0.52 dev accuracy. Gold labels were used only to choose and later score claims. Selection used the baseline's saved dev outputs and is not a random sample of dev.
